summary: Crypto sentiment is cautiously bullish for Bitcoin after a sharp rebound, with Michaël van de Poppe identifying $79,000-$79,800 as critical support and expecting a potential breakout toward year-end.[2][3] Broader risk sentiment remains mixed: crypto still faces ETF outflows and regulatory uncertainty, while available market data shows crude oil weakening and gold near $4,136.70.[3][4][7][10]
